  Interface: sdk

  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY

  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

output_text:
```python
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai
import os

def extract_receipt_data(file_path, project_id, location, processor_id):
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()

    # Set the endpoint
    endpoint = f"{location}-documentai.googleapis.com"
    client.transport._transport._endpoint = endpoint

    # Load the document
    with open(file_path, "rb") as image:
        image_content = image.read()

    # Configure the process request
    document = {"content": image_content, "mime_type": "application/pdf"}
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}", document=document)

    # Process the document
    result = client.process_document(request=request)

    # Initialize extraction variables
    merchant = ""
    tax = ""
    total = ""
    items = []

    # Extract information from the response
    for entity in result.entities:
        if entity.type_ == "VENDOR_NAME":
            merchant = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type_ == "TOTAL":
            total = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type_ == "TAX":
            tax = entity.mention_text
        elif entity.type_ == "LINE_ITEM":
            items.append(entity.mention_text)

    return {
        "merchant": merchant,
        "tax": tax,
        "total": total,
        "items": items
    }

# Usage example
# os.environ["GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"] = "path/to/credentials.json"
# extract_receipt_data("path/to/receipt.pdf", "your-project-id", "your-location", "your-processor-id")
```
